world.title: 'Any new attack will be met with strikes on bases': Iran warns US, rules out nuclear material transfer
world.summary: Iran has stated it will not permit any of its enriched nuclear material to leave the country. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and adviser Mohsen Rezaei emphasized that any new attacks by the United States will be met with retaliatory strikes on U.S. bases. The warning underscores Iran's commitment to maintaining its nuclear material within its borders.

world.title: 'Genocide against Italians': Over 6,000 Italy schools get bomb threats, similar warnings in UK & Ireland
world.summary: Over 6,000 schools in Italy received bomb threats on Wednesday, leading to the evacuation of more than 300 institutions. The threats were sent via identical emails, prompting a nationwide response from law enforcement. Similar warnings were reported in the UK and Ireland. Authorities are investigating the source of the threats, which have caused significant disruption across educational facilities.

world.title: Pakistan Deputy PM Ishaq Dar’s Grandson Among 8 Indicted In Gangrape Of Two Foreigners
world.summary: A court in Lahore, Pakistan, has indicted eight individuals, including the grandson of Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar, in connection with the gang rape of two foreign women. The complainants are Stephanie Adnana Mau-Arun from the Netherlands and Astrid Robinson Baracho from Venezuela. The case has drawn significant attention and highlights ongoing concerns regarding safety for foreign visitors in Pakistan.

business.title: Baird slashes Nvidia price target by 60%, warns of AI slowdown, leadership risks
business.summary: Baird downgraded Nvidia to Neutral from Outperform and reduced its price target by 60% to $200, down from $500. The firm cited concerns over a potential slowdown in artificial intelligence spending, supply constraints, and leadership risks. Nvidia shares have declined 29% since their peak on October 6, reflecting investor apprehension regarding the company's future performance.

business.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq rise as CoreWeave results ease AI spending worries
business.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose on Wednesday following strong earnings from neocloud firm CoreWeave, alleviating concerns over excessive AI spending. The S&P 500 increased by 0.76%, while the Nasdaq gained 1.16%. In contrast, the Dow fell by 0.13%. CoreWeave aims for profitability by 2028, and Nvidia's stock rebounded after significant market value losses.

business.title: Hyundai Genesis GV90 Luxury SUV Patented In India - Launch In 2027?
business.summary: Hyundai Motor Company has patented the Genesis GV90 luxury SUV in India, following its expected debut in August 2026. The GV90 will be part of Hyundai's luxury Genesis brand, similar to how Lincoln relates to Ford. Speculations suggest that the vehicle may launch in India in 2027, marking Hyundai's entry into the luxury car market in the country.

technology.title: Could new iron-based catalysts bring lithium-CO₂ batteries closer to reality?
technology.summary: Research from the University of Surrey indicates that a new class of iron-based catalysts may advance the development of lithium-CO₂ batteries. These batteries aim to be more affordable and sustainable by utilizing carbon dioxide (CO₂). The findings suggest that these catalysts could play a crucial role in enhancing the efficiency and viability of rechargeable battery technology.

technology.title: eMudhra Revokes 8 More CAs It Previously Declared Unaffected by Key Compromise
technology.summary: eMudhra has revoked eight additional certificate authorities (CAs) following a key compromise linked to a Python script that exposed RSA private keys during an HSM transfer. Although the script did not weaken the keys themselves, the incident has led to the revocation of these intermediate CAs, highlighting ongoing security concerns within the company's certificate management processes.

technology.title: Meta brings advanced AI assistant to smart wearables
technology.summary: Meta has introduced its Muse AI assistant for Apple Watches and Google Wear OS smartwatches, allowing users to automate tasks directly from their wrists. This standalone application aims to enhance user experience by providing advanced AI capabilities in wearable technology. The integration signifies Meta's commitment to expanding its AI offerings across various platforms, including smart wearables.

sports.title: Shreyanka Patil named in India A squads for England series
sports.summary: All-rounder Shreyanka Patil has been selected for the India A squad for the upcoming series against England A, scheduled from November 30 in Pune and Mumbai. Anushka Sharma will captain the team for the white-ball matches, while Minnu Mani will lead in the multi-day fixture. This marks Shreyanka's return after her last international appearance at the Asian Games.

sports.title: IND 1-0 MDV Highlights, SAFF Championship: India beats Maldives to enter knockouts
sports.summary: India defeated Maldives 1-0 in the SAFF Championship 2026 match held in Dhaka, Bangladesh, securing a spot in the knockout stage. Suhail Bhatt scored the only goal from a penalty in the first half. India maintained control of possession throughout the match, while also fending off a late challenge from the Maldives to secure the victory.

sports.title: Arshdeep proposes to girlfriend Samreen in New Zealand, shares engagement pictures
sports.summary: India pacer Arshdeep Singh proposed to actor Samreen Kaur in New Zealand, sharing engagement pictures on social media. The announcement followed his recent transfer from Punjab Kings to Mumbai Indians, confirmed ahead of IPL 2027. The couple's engagement marks a significant personal milestone for Singh, coinciding with his professional transition within the Indian Premier League.

health.title: One in four adolescents not getting at least 1 hour of physical activity
health.summary: A World Health Organisation (WHO) report reveals that one in four adolescents globally do not engage in at least 60 minutes of physical activity daily. This equates to approximately 240 million young people at risk of health issues, including heart disease, type 2 diabetes, and certain cancers. The findings highlight the critical need for increased physical activity among youth.

health.title: National diabetes week highlighting prevention, early detection
health.summary: The health ministry is observing national diabetes week from November 11 to 17 to increase public awareness about diabetes. The initiative emphasizes the significance of prevention and early diagnosis for effective management of the disease. The campaign aims to educate the public on diabetes risks and promote healthier lifestyle choices to reduce the prevalence of this chronic condition.

health.title: 4 In 10 Cancer Cases Can Be Prevented By Addressing These 5 Risk Factors, Says WHO
health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) reports that nearly 40% of cancer cases globally could be prevented by addressing five key risk factors. A comprehensive study emphasizes the importance of focusing on prevention strategies. While genetics and age are commonly linked to cancer, this analysis highlights that lifestyle and environmental factors play a significant role in cancer risk management.

science.title: 5 meteors per hour to light up night sky tonight? Northern Taurid Meteor Shower peaks on November 11-12
science.summary: The Northern Taurid Meteor Shower will peak on November 11-12, 2026, offering skywatchers the opportunity to see up to five meteors per hour. This meteor shower is notable for its bright fireballs. Observers in India can check local peak times and visibility conditions to enhance their viewing experience during this celestial event.

science.title: Is the universe older than we think? New model suggests 26.7 billion years
science.summary: A new cosmological model developed by researchers Rajendra Gupta and Nikolaos Samaras at the University of Ottawa suggests the universe may be 26.7 billion years old, nearly double current estimates. This alternative model was announced on November 6 and challenges existing theories about the universe's age, potentially reshaping our understanding of cosmic history and evolution.

science.title: A new dawn of discoveries beyond the horizon
science.summary: The column discusses visible planets and a recent discovery of a new dwarf planet. It also reflects on the stars and commemorates the passing of two actors from the Star Trek franchise, which is celebrating its 60th anniversary. The author notes the early ending of days as the sun moves south, impacting hopes for stargazing.

entertainment.title: Inji Vellam: Mani Ratnam Announces Release Date For Vijay Sethupathi, Sai Pallavi's Film
entertainment.summary: Filmmaker Mani Ratnam has announced that his upcoming romantic drama, Inji Vellam, featuring Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi, will be released in theaters worldwide on January 29, 2027. This film marks the first collaboration between the two actors, generating anticipation among fans. The announcement was made by the production team on Wednesday, confirming the release date.

entertainment.title: Sonu Sood appeals for high stools and seating for airport and hotel staff: ‘A little rest is not a privilege’
entertainment.summary: Sonu Sood is advocating for improved seating arrangements for airport and hotel staff. He emphasized the need for high stools or proper seating to provide employees, who often work long hours, with opportunities to rest. Sood's appeal aims to highlight that adequate rest should not be considered a privilege, but rather a basic necessity for those in the hospitality sector.

entertainment.title: Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone give festive vibes in traditional outfits as they celebrate Diwali; PICS
entertainment.summary: Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone celebrated Diwali 2026 in Bengaluru with family, including Deepika's parents and sister Anisha. The couple shared festive vibes by donning traditional outfits during their intimate gathering. Fans expressed excitement for glimpses of their celebration, as several pictures from the event circulated online, showcasing the couple's joy and connection with their loved ones.
